trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to Brandy Plan
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say Brandy may terminate the license at any time and may suspend or terminate access, which materially limits the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: This license shall automatically terminate if you violate any of these restrictions and may be terminated by Brandy at any time.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be terminated by Brandy at any time, so it is not unconditional lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Brandy reserves the right to ask the user to upgrade to a more suitable plan that better accommodates their usage needs or take other appropriate action, including suspending or terminating access.
exhibits.argument: Brandy can suspend or terminate access, which voids the promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: And SAAS like these are the sole reasons. Good Luck and thankyou for lifetime sub.
exhibits.argument: Buyer thanks seller for lifetime subscription, confirming lifetime access was granted.

exhibits.quote: I'm thankful to have the opportunity to pay a single price and have a great tool to share clients' branding with them.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms paying a single price for ongoing tool access, supporting lifetime access claim.

trials.claim: Lifetime access to all PRO features
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to all PRO features
- Unlimited assets
- Unlimited users
- Unlimited brand spaces
- 10 GB of storage
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the AppSumo deal does not include every feature and were told to upgrade to a business plan to use features, contradicting access to all PRO features.

exhibits.quote: It is true that the AppSumo deal does not include every feature, but considering the price, it offers great value.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the deal does not include every feature, contradicting lifetime access to all PRO features.

exhibits.quote: Features are only available on business plan or higher. Upgrade to the business plan or higher to start using Feature.
exhibits.argument: Buyer was blocked from features and told to upgrade, showing not all PRO features are included.

exhibits.quote: Some things are meant to be private. Lock your brand space and give access to an unlimited number of users.
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists private brand spaces as a Pro feature, supporting access to PRO features.

exhibits.quote: Had a small issue with my account being activated in the free plan instead of the pro plan, but their support responded and immediately corrected the issue.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms account was corrected to pro plan, showing PRO features were provided.

trials.claimQuote:
- Unlimited assets

- Unlimited brand spaces
- 10 GB of storage
## Refund
60-day money-back guarantee
trials.reasoning: The terms specifically say users granted unlimited assets are subject to fair use limitations, so the assets are not truly unlimited despite one review repeating the deal wording.

exhibits.quote: Users who were granted unlimited access to Brandy unlimited brand spaces, assets, and storage are subject to fair use limitations.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited assets are subject to fair use limitations, so they are not truly unlimited.

exhibits.quote: Each plan has limits on brand spaces, assets, and storage, and the features differ on each tier.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states each plan has limits on assets, contradicting unlimited assets.

exhibits.quote: For a deal offering unlimited brands and assets, this is incredible.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the deal offers unlimited brands and assets as promised.

trials.claimQuote:
- Unlimited users
- Unlimited brand spaces
- 10 GB of storage
## Refund
60-day money-back guarantee
trials.reasoning: The vendor states there are no limits or per-seat pricing for inviting users, and the fair-use exhibits listed do not specifically limit users.

exhibits.quote: Users who were granted unlimited access to Brandy unlimited brand spaces, assets, and storage are subject to fair use limitations.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited access including users is limited by fair use, undermining unlimited users.

exhibits.quote: Fair use is defined as the use of the service in a manner that does not exceed reasonable and customary levels of usage.
exhibits.argument: Usage exceeding reasonable levels can be restricted, so users are not truly unlimited.

exhibits.quote: Invite all your colleagues or clients to view and edit the brand space. There are no limits or per-seat pricing.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states there are no limits or per-seat pricing for brand space users, supporting unlimited users.

trials.claimQuote:
- 10 GB of storage
## Refund
60-day money-back guarantee
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms receiving 10GB of storage per space, and needing to upgrade only after reaching a limit does not contradict that 10GB is included.

exhibits.quote: If you reach the limit on your plan, you will need to upgrade to make sure that your account can accommodate your growth.
exhibits.argument: Reaching a storage limit forces an upgrade, undermining that 10 GB is sufficient included storage for lifetime use.

exhibits.quote: Brandy reserves the right to ask the user to upgrade to a more suitable plan that better accommodates their usage needs or take other appropriate action, including suspending or terminating access.
exhibits.argument: Storage access can be suspended, terminated, or require an upgrade, limiting the 10 GB promise.

exhibits.quote: You can build robust, professional brand asset platforms with custom domains, custom branding, personalized OG social images, and 10GB of storage per space.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms receiving 10GB of storage per space as promised.

trials.claim: All future Brandy Plan updates included
trials.claimQuote:

- Please note: This deal is not stackable

trials.reasoning: Buyers report many new features are not included in the AppSumo plan and are restricted to the higher Business plan, contradicting all future updates being included.

exhibits.quote: Went to see the account and there's gazillions of new features but none are included in the app sumo plan.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports new features and updates are not included in the AppSumo plan.

exhibits.quote: These features are only available in the Business Plan ($350 per year) and not in the Pro Plan ($50 per year) offered on AppSumo.
exhibits.argument: Newer-tier features are excluded from the AppSumo Pro plan, contradicting all future updates included.
